description: This Java class defines an immutable event class 'SubjectDeleted' within the Eclipse Ditto project, representing the event emitted after a policy subject has been deleted. It includes methods for creating instances from parameters or JSON, and provides accessors for its properties.

classes.name: SubjectDeleted
classes.description: Immutable event class indicating that a subject was deleted from a policy. Provides methods for JSON serialization/deserialization and accessors for its attributes.

methods.name: getLabel
methods.description: Returns the label associated with the deleted policy entry.

methods.name: getSubjectId
methods.description: Returns the identifier of the deleted subject.

methods.name: getResourcePath
methods.description: Returns the JSON Pointer path to the resource affected by this event.

methods.name: setRevision
methods.description: Creates a new instance with the specified revision.

methods.name: setDittoHeaders
methods.description: Creates a new instance with the specified DittoHeaders.

methods.name: appendPayload
methods.description: Appends event-specific payload fields to the JSON object being constructed.

methods.name: hashCode
methods.description: Generates a hash code based on the object properties.

methods.name: canEqual
methods.description: Helper for equality check, ensuring the other object is of the correct type.

methods.name: toString
methods.description: Returns a string representation of the instance.
